request.query: bound supremum real set strictly below c using a uniform smaller upper bound

items.name: exists_lt_of_lt_csSup'
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrderBot α] {s : Set α} {a : α}, a < sSup s → ∃ b ∈ s, a < b

items.name: lt_sSup_iff
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : CompleteLinearOrder α] {s : Set α} {b : α}, b < sSup s ↔ ∃ a ∈ s, b < a

items.name: Real.sSup_le
items.type: ∀ {s : Set ℝ} {a : ℝ}, (∀ x ∈ s, x ≤ a) → 0 ≤ a → sSup s ≤ a

items.name: Real.exists_isLUB
items.type: ∀ {s : Set ℝ}, s.Nonempty → BddAbove s → ∃ x, IsLUB s x

items.name: csSup_le_iff
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : ConditionallyCompleteLattice α] {s : Set α} {a : α},
  BddAbove s → s.Nonempty → (sSup s ≤ a ↔ ∀ b ∈ s, b ≤ a)

items.name: Real.isLUB_sSup
items.type: ∀ {s : Set ℝ}, s.Nonempty → BddAbove s → IsLUB s (sSup s)

items.name: csSup_le_iff'
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrderBot α] {s : Set α},
  BddAbove s → ∀ {a : α}, sSup s ≤ a ↔ ∀ x ∈ s, x ≤ a

items.name: sup_le
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u} [inst : SemilatticeSup α] {a b c : α}, a ≤ c → b ≤ c → a ⊔ b ≤ c
